notes.title: Demo is Released!
notes.content:
Hi! I am here with some great news—we’ve finally [b]uploaded our demo to Steam[/b], and we’re participating in Steam Next Fest!

[h3][b]I highly recommend playing the demo to get a feel for the game. [/b][/h3]But if you’d rather wait and play the full version, that’s totally fine too!

I’m really excited to hear your feedback—[i]do you like the game[/i]? [i]What could be improved[/i]? [i]Did you encounter any bugs[/i]?
[h3]
If you find any bugs, please report them in the discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/2938980/partnerevents/edit/536594572115968135]here[/url].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45301949/3b0b3fecf8af5388db433b917c75e2f13a1dd1fa.gif[/img]
I truly appreciate any help and feedback. [b]Thank you so much for your support[/b]—[i]we’ll keep working hard on the game![/i]

If you have any questions or want to submit feedback, feel free to email us at: unfriendlyfrienddemo@gmail.com

Have a great day, and stay safe!
